implicit-audit.rule: The countersign writes exactly one ApprovalAudit row in the same transaction: approvedBy=actor, operation=countersign.v6, idempotencyKey=key, fromStatus=pending-second, toStatus=approved, reason NULL; an audit write failure rolls everything back.

go-manual: Drift returns every Purchase whose status is not the toStatus of its latest
go-action: Drift returns every Purchase whose status is not the toStatus of its latest

implicit-request-hash.rule: ActionRequest.requestHash equals ledger.Fingerprint("countersign.v6", [id]) (the confirmed amount is not part of it), so ledger.Verify accepts countersign rows.

implicit-outbox.rule: The countersign writes exactly one PurchaseEvent row in the same transaction: type=purchase.countersigned, purchaseId=id, actorId=actor, idempotencyKey=key; an outbox write failure rolls everything back. In go-action this is the Event value of the new declaration.

go-manual: every Action added after the outbox writes one event per target
go-action: every Action added after the outbox writes one event per target

implicit-uniform-denial.rule: Missing, other-tenant, submitted, approved, self-created and first-approver targets all get the same 4xx status as a missing purchase, so a response never distinguishes existence, ownership or who approved first.

requirements: 本版本的起点已有批量审批（POST /purchases/bulk-approve）、批量驳回（POST /purchases/bulk-reject）和重新提交（POST /purchases/{id}/reopen），并且批量审批已实现金额分级：amount 大于 50000 的采购单经批量审批后只进入中间状态 pending-second（仍列在 approvedIds 中），必须再由另一位 approver 完成二次审批。本任务新增二次审批：POST /purchases/{id}/countersign，请求体为 {"amount":N}，N 为 1..2147483647 的整数，表示二审人核对过的金额。只有已认证的 approver 可以调用；目标必须属于当前租户、状态为 pending-second、不是调用者本人创建的，并且调用者不能是把它推进到 pending-second 的那位 approver。成功后状态变为 approved，返回 200，响应为 {"id":ID,"status":"approved"}。N 与采购单当前金额不一致时返回 409；其他不符合条件的目标返回 4xx；被拒绝的请求数据库全部不变，也不占用 Idempotency-Key。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.Confirm 完成（verb 为 countersign，角色为 approver），新路径通过它注册。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 对同一采购单、同一金额重放时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同采购单返回 409。不同 actor 使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与状态变更在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "countersign.v6"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同请求两次均 200 且只提交一次；对同一采购单使用不同 key 或由不同 approver 同时二审时只能一个成功，失败方返回 4xx。requester 调用返回 403，未认证返回 401；客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。二审后的采购单不能再被批量审批、批量驳回或再次二审。批量审批（含金额分级）、批量驳回、重新提交与原有 API 行为保持不变。
fixed_conditions: guarded RLS, identical v6a schema and tier/second-approver trigger
identical task text; both prompts say to follow the existing code's conventions
same shared HTTP adapter (batch, Item, Confirm), ledger, reconciliation and notify packages
start state: tiered bulk-approve, bulk-reject and reopen hand-written in go-manual; kernel Operation values declared in internal/candidate in go-action
interpretation: Confirmatory replication of the v5b design on a new task (second-level approval). go-action encodes audit, request digest and uniform denial in a protected kernel (action_enforcement=kernel); the outbox event type is a required declaration field (declared). Not evidence of a general platform.
